pages.text: The Chemical Laboratory processes items and fluids. Its three input slots accept two reagents and, for recipes that need one, a container. Supply Forge Energy and the required input fluid.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Place reagents in the first two input slots. Recipes that fill tanks, cells or other containers also use the third slot. The right-hand slots hold the finished items. The fluid bars show the input and output tanks.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Both tanks have a 'dump' button that deletes the content of the tank. $(br)Available ingredients depend on the recipe data and item tags.
